hypothesis: Higher LR may improve learning within the short capped schedule. CE2 did not improve the half-budget gate.
fixed: ViT-B/16, same seed-0 init, XY D4/order, dropout .1, AdamW wd 1e-5, 477-update LR horizon, BF16, batch1, native96cubed

gate.rule: Mean validation Dice at 40% and 50% of total capped arithmetic >= .46
gate.limitation: May reject late improvers; pruned runs are not final-budget results

calibration: Training-only base-loss logit-gradient RMS target .10, p95 cap .50; calibrated arithmetic reserved inside cap

xy_bands.initialization: Fresh seed-0, not finetuning; archived control is not retrained
xy_bands.trigger: Unconditional user authorization, even if lr3 pruned

lr3_bands.trigger: Verified full-budget lr3 final validation Dice strictly > .50

diagnostics: Three separately reported preflight steps per launched arm; established convention
scope: Development pilots only, not completion of 3 seeds / 3 folds
